name: tavg_c
source: WorldClim 2.1 bio1 (annual mean temperature; 1970-2000 normals; 30 arc-seconds)
derivation: terra::extract(rast('wc2.1_30s_bio_1.tif'), site coordinates in WGS84); natural units, the model z-scales internally with the constants in parameters.pt

name: prec_mm
derivation: terra::extract(rast('wc2.1_30s_bio_12.tif'), site coordinates in WGS84); natural units

name: harvest
source: NBI plot record at the second visit (NBI-7 oogstactiviteit = traces of harvest present; NBI-6 soort kap = clearcut or single-tree felling)
derivation: a management dial, constant over the years of a site: 1 = the stand is harvested as the inventory's harvested plots were over an interval (felled share of trees 22 %), 0 = no harvest activity recorded (felled share < 1.5 %); it is realised harvest of the same period in the calibration, so it describes a management regime, it does not forecast one
